editorial:
Imagine spending a relaxing weekend with your best friends at a fancy beach house in Cape Cod, only for things to go south fast. You get caught in a nightmare when a weird orange mist starts leaking from an old factory nearby. To stay safe, the group locks themselves inside, but you quickly realize that being trapped in the house might be just as scary as whatever is waiting in the fog. The vibe is super tense, making you feel the panic as the friends start to turn on each other while they try to figure out how to survive the night.

What really works here is the acting, as the cast makes the fear feel real and the twists keep you guessing. While the middle part of the movie drags a little bit, the scary moments are worth it. If you love thrillers that make you hold your breath, you should definitely check this one out.
endingExplained: In the end, you find out the orange fog isn't just gas, but a living thing that feeds on fear. One by one, the friends are tricked into opening the doors, letting the mist inside. The final twist shows that the main character didn't actually escape; he is just dreaming. He wakes up to find the fog has completely taken over the town, and there is nowhere left to run.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival stories and mysterious monsters.
